message.content: {"summary": {"title": "Four countries award offshore wind capacity in one coordinated round", "summary": "Four countries approved offshore wind capacity in the same week, in a round their regulators had agreed to coordinate. Denmark took the largest award, and Germany, Poland and Ireland each took a smaller one. Every figure is stated in megawatts of nameplate capacity, which is what the joint announcement compares, and none of the four regulators published the prices bid at auction. Analysts noted that an award is not a connection: grid operators in three of the four countries have open queues, and no announcement named a date by which the approved capacity reaches customers."}, "visual": {"type": "bar", "title": "Offshore wind approved", "comparison_basis": "Capacity approved in the same round", "rows": [{"reading": {"evidence_id": "ev2", "interpretation": "as_stated"}, "label": "Denmark"}, {"reading": {"evidence_id": "ev3", "interpretation": "as_stated"}, "label": "Germany"}, {"reading": {"evidence_id": "ev4", "interpretation": "as_stated"}, "label": "Poland"}, {"reading": {"evidence_id": "ev5", "interpretation": "as_stated"}, "label": "Ireland"}]}}
